targets.summary: The newly added Dispatcher function may be unused and should be removed if so.
targets.evidence: Before: `const KernelFunction* backendFallbackKernelForDispatchKey(DispatchKey dk) const {` (line 218). In the merged code that function is gone. Its body was folded into the existing `bool hasBackendFallbackForDispatchKey(DispatchKey dk) const { ... return kernel.isValid(); }`, which no longer calls a helper. The maintainer asked whether the new function was used, and it was removed, so the request was adopted.

targets.summary: The change to the dispatch key extraction hot path may hurt performance, so it should be checked and the function possibly marked C10_ALWAYS_INLINE/forced inline.
targets.evidence: Before: `DispatchKeySet getDispatchKeySetFromRawDispatchKeySet(`. Merged: `C10_ALWAYS_INLINE DispatchKeySet getDispatchKeySetFromRawDispatchKeySet(`. The maintainer suggested forced inlining, and the merged code marks this exact function C10_ALWAYS_INLINE.
